claim: Fontanafredda's 'Barolo of Serralunga' tour costs €45 per person for a 1h30 guided cellar visit plus tasting of three Barolos (Comune di Serralunga, Proprietà in Fontanafredda, Vigna La Rosa); offered in English and Italian, advance booking required, not for under-18s.
quote: Guided tour of Fontanafredda's historical cellars and tasting of three Barolo wines. ... Barolo DOCG del Comune di Serralunga d'Alba 2021, Barolo DOCG Proprietà in Fontanafredda, and Barolo DOCG Vigna La Rosa. ... €45 per person ... 1 hour 30 minutes

claim: Marchesi di Barolo runs by-reservation small-group tours daily 10:30-17:30; 'Journey to Discover Our Land' is €40/person (€45 in harvest, 1/09-30/11) for a 1h30 cellar tour and 3-wine tasting, while 'The King Barolo' is €50/person (€55 in harvest) including a Cru or Riserva.
quote: Journey to Discover Our Land ... 3 selected wines ... at €40/person – duration: 1h30 (from 1/09 to 30/11: €45) ... The King Barolo ... 3 Barolo wines, including at least one Cru or Riserva at €50/person – duration: 1h30

claim: Ceretto owns three Langhe estates — Monsordo Bernardina (Alba HQ), Bricco Rocche (Castiglione Falletto, with the iconic glass Cube over Brunate) and Bricco Asili (Barbaresco) — and offers two signature tours: 'Wine and Art' (Brunate Chapel + cellar + tasting) and 'Barolo and Architecture' (Bricco Rocche Cube + Monsordo + tasting), seven days a week by appointment via visit@ceretto.com / +39 0173 268033.
quote: Ceretto owns three estates: Monsordo Bernardina in Alba, Bricco Rocche in Castiglione Falletto, and Bricco Asili in Barbaresco ... 'Wine and Art' ... 'Barolo and Architecture' ... seven days a week (by prior appointment) ... +39 0173 268033 or visit@ceretto.com

claim: Pio Cesare's cellar in central Alba accepts visits Monday-Saturday morning by appointment only (visite@piocesare.it / +39.0173.440386); the tasting includes Barolo, Barbaresco and private-collection bottles but the producer is effectively closed to the public and grants only occasional exceptions.
quote: open from Monday until Saturday morning ... tours and tastings to be booked by appointment only ... +39.0173.440386, Email: visite@piocesare.it ... guided tour of the historic cellar and a tasting of prestigious wines, including Barolo, Barbaresco

claim: G.D. Vajra (Vergne hamlet, 3 km above Barolo) takes visits by appointment Mon-Sun 10:00-13:00 and 15:00-18:00 via welcome@gdvajra.it / +39 0173.56257, offering a guided cellar tour plus tasting of four wines including a current-vintage Barolo, with dedicated tracks for First-Time, Returnee, Wine Professionals and hotel/agency partners.
quote: Monday-Sunday, 10:00-13:00 and 15:00-18:00 ... welcome@gdvajra.it ... +39 0173.56257 ... FIRST TIME AT G.D.VAJRA ... RETURNEE ... WINE PROFESSIONALS ... BOOK FOR YOUR GUESTS (hotels & travel agencies)

claim: Vietti in Castiglione Falletto requires online booking with fixed daily slots at 09:00, 10:30, 14:30 and 16:30; choices include classic and 'experience' tastings (rare vintages, private settings) plus a signature Trekking Experience walking the Scarrone, Rocche and Villero crus at sunrise/sunset.
quote: Classic or experience tastings ... 'Trekking Experience' through vineyards in MGAs Scarrone, Rocche, and Villero at sunrise/sunset ... Direct reservations required ... info@vietti.com, +39.0173.62825

claim: Reviewer reports for Vietti put the classic tasting plus full production tour at roughly €25 per person, with English-language guides standard.
quote: €25 per person for a classic tasting plus a full tour of production

claim: Paolo Scavino, the fourth-generation Castiglione Falletto producer, is open by appointment Monday-Friday 09:00-12:30 and 14:30-18:00; advance booking via +39 0173 62850 is mandatory.
quote: Booking in advance is necessary to secure a tour. The winery is open by appointment, operating from Monday to Friday from 9 am to 12.30 pm and from 2.30 pm to 6 pm. ... +39 (0173) 62850

claim: Damilano runs a free walk-in wine shop in the village of Barolo (Via Roma 31, daily 10:30-18:30) plus formal/informal tasting tables at the cellar (Mon-Fri 8:30-12:30 and 14:30-18:00, weekends 10:00-18:00); the on-site Massimo Camia Ristorante is the lunch option for tour-plus-meal day trips, and the producer farms the iconic Cannubi hill beside which sits one of the original Big Benches.
quote: A counter at the back for information and purchases, a raised table with stools for informal tastings and a round marble white table with transparent chairs for formal and ritual tastings ... Barolo Wine Shop ... Via Roma 31, Barolo ... Daily 10:30am–6:30pm

claim: Produttori del Barbaresco — the 1958 cooperative vinifying fruit from over fifty Nebbiolo growers — offers a free walk-in tasting at its village wine shop (Mon-Fri 9-13/14-18, Sat-Sun 10-18); proper cellar tours require booking well in advance via produttori@produttoridelbarbaresco.com / +39 0173 635139.
quote: open to the public for tastings without an appointment necessary, but for a cellar tour, an appointment well in advance is essential ... +39 0173635139 ... produttori@produttoridelbarbaresco.com

claim: Gaja's Barbaresco estate is closed to the general public; the gates opened in 2014 only for fully-personalised tours conditional on 'a sizeable donation to charity', and slots must be booked months ahead.
quote: The gates were opened up to the public in 2014 but you'll only enter into these romantic courtyards after a sizeable donation to charity ... book your tour or tasting months ahead, especially for peak season

claim: Cantina del Pino in Barbaresco (Via Rabajà 80), run by Renato Vacca, takes visits strictly by appointment via renato@cantinadelpino.com / +39 0173 635147 — allow roughly two hours, with focus on the Ovello and Albesani crus.
quote: Tel. +39 0173 635147 • Email renato@cantinadelpino.com • www.cantinadelpino.com ... Via Rabaja, no. 80 BARBARESCO 12050 ... Allow approximately 2 hours per visit

claim: Marchesi Alfieri, the baroque-castle estate at San Martino Alfieri (just outside the 30 km radius in Asti province), runs guided tours of the cellar, English garden and Orangerie with a four-wine tasting from €20-25 per person, bookable via WineTourism.com or direct.
quote: Wine tasting tours are available starting at €20.00 and €25.00 ... tour will take you through the beautiful English garden ... ancient cellar located beneath the Orangerie ... four exceptional wines

claim: Cantina Bartolo Mascarello (Via Roma 15, Barolo) — the cult traditionalist run today by Maria Teresa — has no website, requires a phone reservation on +39 0173 56125 or rv@bartolomascarello.com, and offers a free tasting and cellar tour but no on-site purchase because production is sold out before bottling.
quote: You must call ahead to make a reservation, and the winery does not have a website ... +39 0173 56125 ... due to the high demand ... you cannot buy wine at the winery, but you can still have a free tasting and tour of the cellars

claim: Langhe Experience packages a full-day Barolo-and-Barbaresco day trip with two cellar visits and a three-course tasting-menu lunch in a local restaurant, the standard format used by Boscareto guests who want lunch baked into the winery day.
quote: tastings of Barolo and Barbaresco wines and a traditional lunch in a local restaurant with a tasting menu of 3 courses, along with guided visits to historical wineries
